limits: Each sheet contains five views and nine still samples, with each image reduced to a 180px tile.
Still samples cannot prove timing, acceleration, foot locking, short-lived intersections or smooth action interruption.
The plain background has no calibrated floor grid; support is described as visible pose evidence, not a measured clearance verdict.
The capture uses a neutral expression, so expression appropriateness was not scored as a body-motion defect.
Every action remains pending full normal-speed, quarter-speed and actual small-avatar playback review.

actions.observed: Middle samples show alternating knees and feet, bent elbows and a strong forward trunk lean. Side views expose fore/aft limb separation that the front view hides. No open neck seam or detached limb is visible.
actions.supportAndTransition: A lower foot and raised trailing foot can be distinguished in the active samples; first and last samples return to the same upright silhouette.
actions.concern: The large trunk lean could read as a hunched dash at small size. Still samples cannot decide whether the short active run interval is naturally timed.
remaining: Actual Host travel and foot-lock measurement

actions.supportAndTransition: The feet remain beneath a bent lower body in the sampled arch. First and last samples recover the neutral silhouette; the intervening acceleration and load transfer are unknown.
actions.concern: The head/chest relationship is visibly extreme for this short body and may read as a contortion instead of a cute flourish. No definite open seam is visible; this is a pose and timing concern, not a proven skin tear.

actions.concern: The turning foot and close-to-belly hand can be occluded. A short unsupported or intersecting interval may fall between the samples.
